title: Spinor double-cover gate for Moebius-ball import

gate_tests.test: Otto 13 half-turn path not closed as pure spinor period

w33_import_requirement.spinor_anchor: W33 has existing Sp(4,R) ~ Spin(2,3) to Dirac spinor bridge in BT376
w33_import_requirement.required_extra_for_otto: explicit closure/chirality identification for the odd 13th half-turn

decision: The path has spinor-relevant half-turn arithmetic, but 13 half-turns are not by themselves a closed spin-1/2 double-cover proof. Import remains gated.
